priority_method.basis: Highest associated law-profile score, using case metadata; not a case misuse finding.
priority_method.uncertainty: A score range crossing a band boundary is Priority to confirm. Unknown scores are not zero.
priority_method.sorting: High, to confirm, elevated, standard, unscored; then score lower bound and latest order.
priority_method.validation: Provisional interface thresholds, not expert-validated or learned from outcomes.
